raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. criticize in a severe way, mengecam /hebat, keras/: he has been ~d by the press for his action, dia telah dikecam hebat oleh pihak akhbar krn tindakannya. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
